newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Sept machinery investment up 15.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Sept machinery investment up 15.8 pct.

text.p: China's investment in its machinery industry was 24.7 billion yuan ($2.97 billion) in January to September, up 15.8 percent compared with the same period a year ago, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
Investment in the electronics sector in the first nine months shot up by a year-on-year 65.2 percent to 12.8 billion yuan, Xinhua quoted figures from the State Statistical Bureau as saying.
China invested 34.0 billion yuan in light industry in the period, up 36 percent, while investment in the textile industry rose by 14.3 percent to 11.7 billion yuan, the agency said.
